flags: modiin: founded set to the 2003 merger (Modi'in + Maccabim-Re'ut) per the merged-municipality rule; Maccabim dates from 1985 (CBS 1986) and Modi'in city was populated from 1996. If the city should appear earlier, revert to founded 1986 (S004 cite kept in founded_cite).
maalot_tarshiha: founded set to the joint council's legal start (declared 4 Oct 1962, effective start of Oct 1962; inaugurated 16 May 1963), not the commonly quoted 1963; 1961 population dropped.
yavne, tirat_carmel: CBS gives year only (1949); status starts 1949-01 (start of founding year), supported by quotes that immigrants were housed there from the end of 1948.
ashdod: founded changed 1956 -> 1955 to match the CBS row quoted; status still starts 1956 (first residents).
tel_sheva: Hebrew Wikipedia gives 1968, English Wikipedia 1967; used 1968.
New sources S2000-S2006 are Hebrew Wikipedia articles (verbatim quotes opened via the checker's fetch); no non-wiki page found for the merger/Bedouin-township dates without WebSearch.
